raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE
Transition Management professional with 7+ years of experience leading global service migrations from US and UK to India delivery centers within financial services. Experienced in managing the end-to-end transition lifecycle including transition planning, knowledge transfer (KT), ramp-up strategy, governance, and risk management. Proven ability to align global stakeholders, implement structured transition frameworks, and ensure seamless handover into steady-state operations with minimal disruption. Strong communicator and trusted partner to senior leadership, onsite SMEs, and global delivery teams, driving transition success through structured governance, risk management, and continuous process improvement.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
eClerx Services Limited
Process Manager – Transition Programs
JANUARY 2024 - APRIL 2025
Led strategic transition of ETF and Balance Order middle-office workstreams from US onshore teams to India delivery operations, managing the end-to-end transition lifecycle from planning, knowledge transfer, ramp-up, to stabilization. Created comprehensive knowledge transfer frameworks, ensuring teams acquired all process, system, and compliance knowledge efficiently. Designed structured handover processes, including readiness checklists, training roadmaps, and documentation standards, to enable smooth adoption by new teams. Maintained a centralized repository for all transition documents, including SOPs, process flows, training guides, and progress trackers, enhancing visibility and compliance. Led daily and weekly governance calls and prepared leadership reports to track knowledge transfer, risks, and transition milestones. Managed RAID logs, identified risks proactively, and escalated complex issues to leadership to ensure timely resolution and uninterrupted transition progress. Collaborated with cross-functional and cross-geography stakeholders, ensuring alignment and agreement on timelines, responsibilities, and knowledge transfer objectives. Implemented quality assurance protocols during KT sessions, validating process understanding and reducing errors during handover. Developed team ramp-up strategies, allocating resources effectively, tracking adoption, and confirming readiness for full operational responsibility. Conducted post-transition initiatives, continuous implementing lessons learned and process optimizations to enhance future transition effectiveness. Introduced process improvement initiatives during the transition, streamlining workflows, reducing redundancies, and improving overall efficiency. Ensured consistent communication across all transparency and building confidence among leadership, SMEs, and delivery teams. Supported integration of IT, compliance, and process teams to ensure smooth access, system readiness, and alignment before the go-live phase. Successfully stabilized the transitioned processes, enabling teams to operate

Wells Fargo - Bangalore
SENIOR SECURITIES TRANSITION REPRESENTATIVE
JANUARY 2023 - NOVEMBER 2023
Directed end-to-end transition of Private Equity and Hedge Fund workstreams from US onshore teams to India delivery centers, managing the full transition lifecycle including planning, KT, ramp-up, and post-transition stabilization.
Designed and executed multi-phase Knowledge Transfer frameworks (Shadowing, Reverse Shadowing, Go-Live) to
ensure structured transfer of process and technical knowledge.
Developed transition governance frameworks, including readiness assessments, KPI dashboards, and executive
reporting structures, to monitor progress, identify risks, and ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
Led cross-functional collaboration across global SMEs, compliance, and delivery teams, facilitating smooth execution
and alignment of transition milestones.
Established standardized transition playbooks, SOPs, and documentation repositories, ensuring process compliance
and audit readiness.
Maintained RAID logs, tracked risks, and escalated critical issues, implementing mitigation strategies to prevent
disruption during the transition.
Conducted weekly governance sessions with senior leadership and onshore stakeholders, reporting progress,
decisions, and risks, and ensuring visibility across all transition streams.
Designed scalable ramp-up and training plans, enabling workforce readiness and seamless adoption of newly
transitioned processes.
Provided strategic recommendations on process optimization, team readiness, and KT effectiveness, contributing to
continuous improvement across transition programs.
Goldman Sachs - Bangalore
TRANSITION SPECIALIST (CONSULTANT)
JULY 2022 - DECEMBER 2022
Managed strategic transition and remediation programs for Broker-Dealer documentation and compliance workflows,
ensuring smooth knowledge transfer and alignment with global standards.
Validated Wolfsberg Due Diligence Questionnaires (CBDDQ/FCCQ) and high-risk compliance documentation to enable
accurate handover and regulatory adherence.
Developed and implemented transition governance models, RACI matrices, and standardized documentation
frameworks, ensuring 100% methodology compliance.
Served as central governance POC for third-party vendor teams, monitoring transition progress, resolving process
queries, and escalating risks where necessary.
Led Knowledge Transfer initiatives, ensuring comprehensive coverage of compliance and operational processes across
regions.
Engineered process improvement initiatives during transition programs, increasing efficiency, enhancing adoption, and
reducing ramp-up time.
Coordinated with global stakeholders across multiple time zones, securing alignment, approvals, and buy-in for complex
transition programs.
J P Morgan & Chase Bank - Bangalore
ANALYST (CONSULTANT)
APRIL 2021 - MAY 2022
Supported transition execution for complex documentation, account onboarding, and legal agreements (ISDA, CSA,
Collateral, Futures & Options), ensuring seamless knowledge transfer from onshore teams to India.
Developed structured transition documentation, SOPs, training materials, and migration workflows, supporting smooth
adoption of processes.
Conducted transition readiness assessments, operational adoption reviews, and governance updates, identifying gaps and
implementing mitigation strategies.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams including Legal, Credit, Collateral, and Compliance to ensure all transition
requirements were met without operational disruption.
Implemented tracking mechanisms for transition milestones and KT coverage, ensuring all critical process and compliance
areas were fully transferred.
Provided feedback and recommendations on improving knowledge transfer, documentation quality, and process
adoption for future transition initiatives.
Deutsche Bank - Bangalore
Transition Analyst (Consultant)
FEB 2019- JULY 2019
Executed the migration of wholesale payments and reconciliation processes from global hubs to India, ensuring
smooth knowledge transfer and accurate documentation for steady-state operations.
Developed transition documentation, process guides, and training materials to support onboarding and ramp-up of
the India-based team.
Conducted Knowledge Transfer sessions with subject matter experts, tracked coverage, and addressed gaps to
ensure complete operational readiness.
Collaborated with cross-functional and global stakeholders to align timelines, clarify responsibilities, and ensure
seamless process adoption.
Supported readiness assessments and post-transition reviews, confirming teams were equipped to manage
processes independently.
Assisted in governance reporting, providing leadership with insights on progress, risks, and KT outcomes.
J P Morgan & Chase Bank - Bangalore
Transition Analyst
SEPTEMBER 2017- FEBRUARY 2019
Assisted in the transition of Claims Management and SWIFT reconciliation processes from onshore teams to India,
ensuring proper documentation of all workflows.
Supported the preparation of transition charters, knowledge transfer materials, and readiness checklists to guide the
team during the migration.
Participated in post-transition reviews and performance checks to confirm the adoption of processes and identify areas
for improvement.
Collaborated with stakeholders across different regions to facilitate smooth handover and alignment of responsibilities. Gained exposure to end-to-end transition processes, knowledge transfer planning, and documentation standards,
building foundational skills in global process migration.

ACHEIVEMENTS
Successfully transitioned multiple complex financial workstreams, including securities settlements, client onboarding,
reconciliations, collateral operations, and compliance processes from US/UK to India delivery centers.
Designed scalable training programs, knowledge transfer frameworks, and governance structures that enhanced
transition efficiency and team readiness.
Recognized by global stakeholders for effective cross-border coordination, risk mitigation, and successful stabilization of
newly transitioned processes.
Improved process consistency, documentation standards, and audit readiness across multiple transition programs.
